prose_updates.tldr: For equal-arm stationary homogeneous marked-history service experiments, the paper derives a compact-uniform joint occupation-and-rate-score Gaussian law from exact finite-chain Poisson martingales. Evaluating the exact stationary product law at estimated rates while holding implemented capacity fixed gives fitted-center variance \(Q=A^{\mathsf T}\Gamma A\), residual variance \(W=V-Q\), and uniformly valid Wald coverage for arbitrary joint divergence of \(N\) and \(T_N\). The proved kink residual makes the diffusion center an \(O(N^{-1})\)-accurate corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\). For capacity choice, the staffing radius \(G\) is an exact nonnegative rational design datum; explicit energy, tail, transcendental, and split-quadrature bounds construct a sound rational objective oracle on \([-G,G]\), and rational dyadic branch-and-bound returns a finite checkable certificate.

project_justification.fill: The paper proves stationary diffusion and Poisson-energy limits, a primitive martingale joint central limit law, the exact product-law fitted-center Wald theorem without a horizon upper bound, the uniform kink residual, and the diffusion corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\). For an exact supplied rational staffing radius, it also constructs a sound model-specific rational objective oracle with finite receipts; the generic dyadic certificate theorem computes its stopping depth by rational comparison, and uniform diffusion-energy transfer gives \(\epsilon+o(1)\) finite-system regret.

prose_updates.interpretation: The exact fitted interval targets the implemented stationary operational effect, not a diffusion estimand: at the true rates the product-law map equals \(\theta_N\) exactly. Same-path rate fitting projects the empirical occupation fluctuation onto the marked rate scores, producing fitted-center variance \(Q\) and empirical-minus-fitted variance \(W=V-Q\). The diffusion center is computationally simpler but inherits \(T_N=o(N)\) from its proved \(O(N^{-1})\) approximation error. For design, an exact rational radius makes the feasible root and its boundary points exactly representable; the constructed rational oracle encloses the limiting capacity--precision objective, the generic certificate theorem terminates after a comparison-defined dyadic depth, and the regret theorem transfers the recommendation to the finite system up to \(\epsilon+o(1)\).
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The floating-point witness at \((\lambda,\tau,\nu,\gamma)=(1,1,1,0)\) remains diagnostic rather than a theorem output. Capacity certification requires the planning radius \(G\) to be supplied exactly as a nonnegative rational; the remaining inputs may be supplied by shrinking rational boxes. The constructive proof may refine those boxes, the truncation radius, series orders, quantile bracket, and Darboux partition without a practical worst-case running-time bound. The kink residual is proved uniformly, including kink-crossing jumps and ceiling phases, and \(K_{\mathrm{res}}\) is a proved finite constant. Marked recovery causes, stationary initialization, independent equal-sized arms, homogeneous compactly positive rates, and a bounded critical staffing window remain substantive restrictions.
prose_updates.honest_scope: Exact finite-chain fitted centering and empirical inference require only \(N,T_N\to\infty\); no upper relation between duration and enrollment is imposed. The diffusion fitted center differs by \(O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})\), so the proved route gives its Wald law under \(T_N/N\to0\). The paper does not claim results for the anchor's unequal-arm class, unmarked histories, common shocks, arbitrary initialization, heterogeneous rates, vanishing-rate boundaries, post-assignment randomization inference, or clinical cure effects. Capacity certification applies to the compact critical-offset objective on \([-G,G]\) when \(G\in\mathbb Q_{\geq0}\) is supplied exactly and the other inputs have rational interval names; it proves termination and finite checkability, not a uniform polynomial complexity bound.

statement_notes.justification: The theorem constructs the missing model-specific sound oracle from a proved energy modulus and finite rational point-evaluation receipts on an exactly represented rational staffing interval.
statement_notes.gap: No oracle-soundness or irrational-boundary premise remains; termination is proved without a sharp practical worst-case complexity bound.
statement_notes.consumer: Together with the generic certificate theorem and finite-design regret transfer, it yields a checkable staffing recommendation for the stated compact model class with exact rational radius.

statement_notes.justification: The theorem gives finite certificate semantics and a worst-case dyadic termination bound computed entirely by rational comparisons, including nonconvex objectives and boundary optima.
statement_notes.gap: It remains a generic result conditional on sound receipts; the separate model-specific theorem supplies such receipts for this objective.
statement_notes.consumer: Instantiating it with the constructed oracle produces a checkable global staffing certificate on the exact rational feasible interval.

statement_notes.justification: Uniform diffusion-energy convergence transfers the limiting-objective certificate on the exact rational staffing interval to the finite integer-capacity system.
statement_notes.gap: The transfer retains its stated \(o(1)\) approximation term; the oracle-construction and root-representability gaps are discharged upstream.
statement_notes.consumer: The constructed oracle, rational dyadic certificate, and this transfer give the staffing manager a checkable \(\epsilon+o(1)\) finite-system regret guarantee.
